about: Adjustments on part of a photo (a retouch layer of kind adjust), shared byte for byte by both phones' tests. cover: how much a layer shows at a pixel for its area, from what its strokes and the photo's subject cover there (the iPhone's; Android has no subject and uses the strokes' cover). mix: a channel of the adjusted copy mixed into the picture's by that, rounded half up; mixPixels: the same for whole 0xAARRGGBB pixels, alpha too. photos: Android's parity photos (a 16 x 16 ramp, red 16 a column, green 16 a row, blue 8 a step of either, under one layer, FNV-1a over red, green, blue, alpha); the iPhone draws them through Core Image and does not hash them. layer: an adjust layer as both phones write it, keys sorted: no hsl, no vignette, and no curve when there is none.

photos.name: subject, on Android the strokes' cover
